en: A color postcard showing a bright, sunny view of a large Romanesque-style cathedral with four tall towers and a greenish roof, fronted by an open square with flower beds, a statue on a pedestal, trees, benches, and surrounding historic buildings. The lower front margin bears the caption "PÉCS". The reverse side is mostly blank except for printed publisher information and the title of the scene.
